Name: Barrack
Description: A barrack to provide formal and standard martial drilling. Even dog soldiers can become better than human militia with the right training regimen.

Name: War Stable
Description: A good warhorse requires intensive care and the finest feeding. Unlike farm horses, these war horses are exceptionally sturdy and not so easy to spook. Every good knight requires a good warhorse.

Name: Temple
Description: A place of worship. What is true happiness but to be in service to the divine?

Name: Grain Field
Description: Grain. One may say it is the first essential component to grow a society. So start a grain field and solve the necessity of sustenance.

Name: Granary
Description: A granary is crucial for efficient grain-based food production operations. The stored grains can be used for long-term ration planning and commerce. Additionally, since grains last much longer with proper storage, more thorough research can be achieved to improve livestock feeding.

Name: Tavern
Description: A place that can provide the best legal entertainment. Alcohol, bed, community, music, and performance, this place has them all.

Name: Market
Description: An aggregation of commerce where capital from all over the realm are gathered and transacted by established and travelling merchants. There is simply no better method to efficiently generate money than in the market.

Name: Slum
Description: A slum is a gathering of society's undesirables. A place outside of the reach of the law, and no less savage than the natural world. Despite its prevalent ill effects on civilisation, the underworld can be a useful place for morally questionable transactions away from the eyes of God.

Name: Brothel
Description: An establishment for housing the most important profession in the world. Brothels are indeed officially illegal and condemned. By placing them in the slum with a legal front business, they can bring the debauchery of forbidden ecstasy for those with the means to obtain it.

Name: Motte-and-bailey
Description: A motte-and-bailey castle is a small fortification for protecting a small settlement. The defensive and self-sustained design allows it to be a living space for the regional lord. Monsters and raiders will have difficulty taking down these bastions of civilisation.

Name: Stronghold
Description: A stronghold is a sizable walled settlement that can house a small army for a long period of time. Even an army will require an effort to penetrate its defence. They also serve as a place of power and ruling in peacetime.

Name: Castle
Description: A castle is the very centre of a region. Civilisations require an epicentre to maintain a semblance of society, and there is no better place than where no external hostilities can reach. A small settlement typically emerges around the castle, and together they become the walled city.

Name: Barber
Description: Barbers are trained in the art of cutting; they know how to cut hair and body parts somewhat safely. So barbers also provide medical services to the community.

Name: Forestry
Description: Civilisation cannot exist without nature. A balance is required to be maintained between order and chaos. So forestry assumes the role in that management.

Name: Court Library
Description: martial department funding is 10-to-1 to that of magical one.

Name: Conservatory
Description: The beauty of the sea should be preserved for future generations. Reaping the benefit without care will only result in destruction, this conservatory will attempt to protect the area from unauthorised sea poaching and harvesting.

Name: Lumber
Description: Lumbers are fundamental materials for most types of dolls and their settlements. So a lumber mill like this must be built.

Name: Comfy Doll House
Description: A very comfy doll house. Modest and warm, this house provides a good memory.

Name: Free Gem Deposit
Description: An available gold deposit that can make any person rich.

Name: Free Gold Deposit
Description: An available gem deposit that can make any person prosperous.

Name: Free Iron Deposit
Description: An available iron deposit that is indispensable for developing a civilised economy.

Name: Free Port Space
Description: Free available space for establishing a sea port that can yield supplies and gold.

Name: Free Settlement Space
Description: Free available space for starting a settlement. A faction cannot acquire the region without an established settlement.

Name: Bird House
Description: A bird house for the eagles. They do not require much, just basic necessities, and a good sturdy roof is enough to satisfy them.

Name: Mew
Description: A bird mansion for the eagles. Superb comfort, superb caretakers. The eagles live like royalty in this mew.

Name: Siege Guild
Description: A siege guild housing smart rabbitmen engineers. Sacrificing the simple happiness of nature for the capability of civilised warfare, the vertkins will be ready for true wars.

Name: Warrior Warren
Description: A warren for housing rabbitman warriors. If the rabbitmen are to go to war, they will require special training and respite.

Name: Noble Warren
Description: Only proven rabbitman warriors can become a noble. And with that comes a great privilege to rest in an extra nice noble warren.

Name: Snail House
Description: A snail house with a good and balanced humidity�system. Snails can live happily and safely in these places.

Name: Dark Hole
Description: A deep, dark hole for rabbitmen to brood over the unfairness of the world. After a long period of brooding, they will become a cold and cruel rabbitman who has no qualms about killing. They may even come to enjoy such malicious acts.

Name: Shrine
Description: A little shrine to offer gratitude to the spirit of the place. Not particularly grandiose, but it provides little joy to anyone who visits it. The place also features a small exchange where visitors can trade souvenirs and trinkets for gold.

Name: Garden
Description: A food garden. Not as efficient as a farm, but rabbitmen do not require as much subsistence compared to larger people.

Name: Carrot Farm
Description: A primitive carrot farm. Since carrots are easy to grow, a simple farm like this one is enough to provide for a small community of rabbitmen.

Name: Flower Garden
Description: Beautiful and delicious snacks, flower gardens are a favourite of rabbitmen.

Name: Water Spring
Description: A water spring provides entertainment for most vertkins. It occasionally serves as a communal space for frolicking activities.

Name: Rabbit Tower
Description: A rabbitman tower to overlook the warren. Not the most durable of structures, but it provides a nice deterrent against small-time predators.

Name: Music Tower
Description: Not everything created for war has to be only about war. Rabbitmen also find joy in life through music, so they tend to adapt the tower into a music tower in peacetime.

Name: Trader
Description: A trader's lodge. Nature exists to be used, so perhaps a little bit of taking should be fine.

Name: Hunting Log
Description: A hunter's lodge. All other lives exist to be used, so perhaps a little bit of taking should be fine.

Name: Tiny Warren
Description: A tiny warren that can house no more than a hundred rabbitmen. A good start.

Name: Small Warren
Description: A small warren that can house hundreds of rabbitmen. A new commune is shaping up to become the cornerstone of this little domain.

Name: Moderate Warren
Description: A moderate warren that can house a thousand rabbitmen. A tall mound yet also deep into the earth, a complex network of accommodation stretches far and wide.

Name: Nice Warren
Description: A nice warren that provides comfort to thousands of rabbitmen. Beyond mere survival, this warren is stocked with commodities and equipments to provide happy times.

Name: Fur Hardener
Description: A fur hardener hut that focuses on producing and improving chemical solutions to toughen rabbitman's fur for natural protection in battle.
